searches.reason: Keep joint lexical-residual HSTU as the first experiment, preserving its objective. Seek practical ways to learn specific functional or experiential distinctions from titles/descriptions using tokens trained from scratch, with scale matching and missing-text handling. Test whether these features improve the four-category validation macro HR@10; broad lexical similarity alone may reproduce the diagnosed failures.

searches.reason: Explore an objective-only alternative after the lexical experiment. Training margins do not establish generalization, so retain the pinned validation benchmark for selection.

searches.reason: Explore a separate temporal HSTU alternative using observed timestamps and jointly trained relative-time gates. Investigate whether the model can distinguish short-lived purchase intent from persistent interests without assuming that history-removal sensitivity proves intent or that a purchased item implies a satisfied need.
